mr_title: Implemented async auth backends and utils.

expected_issues.title: Overridden process_request() silently bypassed after the middleware rewrite
expected_issues.description:
RemoteUserMiddleware no longer derives from MiddlewareMixin and no longer calls process_request(), so subclasses that customise authentication by overriding process_request() are silently bypassed.

Projects commonly subclass RemoteUserMiddleware and override process_request() (for example to accept the header only from a trusted proxy, or to map external identities). The rewrite to a plain sync/async middleware implements the logic directly in __call__/__acall__, so an overridden process_request() is never called: the custom checks stop running without any error or warning, and requests are authenticated with the default behaviour. The old hook must keep being honoured (or deprecated with a warning).
